scene: The bell chime summons a tiny glowing key from a hidden drawer.
picture: A flat side view of the quirky hotel lobby. At the left, the mahogany desk now has a small secret drawer slid open, revealing a glowing key. The player stands left of centre in her red jacket and roller skates. At centre, the brass cubic bellhop blinks. On the far right is a miniature open dumbwaiter lift.
shown: a pulsing golden key resting on a velvet cushion at the left desk
the cubic brass bellhop robot tilting its square head at centre
an open brass dumbwaiter shaft with a dangling rope on the far right
